additional_info.subject: AW: ID0472073-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/T3314161484002] Door Clearance Issue CRM:03209000100
additional_info.body:
Dear Priscilla,
Thank you for your response.
However, I would like to clarify that
the door switch component itself is not defective
.
The issue is that
the door does not close properly because the cable/rope for the mechanism is too tightly tensioned
.
We do not need to replace the door switch.
Instead, we kindly request
instructions on how to access the rope box
so we can adjust the cable tension accordingly.
Please provide guidance on accessing and adjusting the rope mechanism.
Thank you for your support.
With best regards,
